info.description: Related-campus opt-in creates one canonical native post and one shared discussion graph. Omitted or false opt-in retains historical publication behavior. Fresh opt-in requires current home identity, explicit school configuration, accepted current Campus topology and exact Review applicability; unsupported shapes fail closed. Capabilities are advisory. Public distribution uses current accepted groups and preserves all Review, Media, Safety and owner-hidden checks. Post.space and content identifiers remain canonical. isRelatedCampusSync is true only in another eligible view; sourceRegion is safe public metadata. Missing optional metadata is not authority. relatedCampusDistribution unavailable means same-school results remain available without proving remote completeness. Detail viewSpaceId only selects display context. Children inherit the root binding and never accept client sync choices. Separate owner documents define pin v2, removal v3, explicit unsupported Profile capabilities and settings v2.
info.title: WhaleU related-campus publication and distribution

post.description: Replies inherit the canonical root. Their existing path/root-comment identifier, optional targetReplyId and imageAssetIds handling already canonicalizes UUIDs to lowercase before constructing the inherited envelope; this rule does not impose a new lowercase-input rejection on replies. The v4-only check runs after original-key receipt recovery and before new Review submission or approval issuance. Legacy none input schemas, normalization and hash bytes are unchanged; never rewrite a frozen historical request to lowercase.
